app.title: PDF Toolbox
app.tagline: Local PDF tools built for teachers
app.privacy: Everything runs in your browser. Your files are never uploaded to any server.

common.dropPdf: Drop a PDF here, or click to choose a file
common.dropImages: Drop images here, or click to choose files (JPG / PNG)
common.done: Done — your file has been downloaded.

error.encrypted: This PDF is password-protected. Please unlock it first.
error.notImage: Please drop a JPG or PNG image.
error.corrupt: Could not read this file — it may be damaged.
error.oom: The file is too large for your browser's memory. Try a smaller file.
error.missingZip: A required component is missing, so files cannot be packaged for download. Please reload the page; if this persists, let the maintainer know.
error.noOutput: No files were produced, so there is nothing to download.
error.rangeOutOfBounds: Range {part} is out of bounds (the document has {totalPages} pages)
error.rangeReversed: Range {part} has a start page greater than its end page
error.everyNInvalid: The number of pages per file must be a positive whole number

warn.filesSkipped: Skipped {n} unsupported file(s); only the supported ones were added.
warn.onlyFirstUsed: This tool only processes one file at a time — only this one will be used: {name}
warn.unequalStacks: {front} front pages and {back} back pages don't match — a page may have been missed while scanning. This is expected if the last sheet is single-sided; you can still continue.

split.title: Split
split.roster: Class list (optional, one name per line)
split.rosterHint: Copy a column from Excel and paste it here. Leave blank to use the naming pattern below.
split.rosterShort: The list has {roster} names but {count} files will be produced. The rest use the naming pattern.
split.rosterLong: The list has {roster} names, more than the {count} files produced. The extras were ignored.
split.shortPart: This part has fewer than {n} pages
split.dupName: Duplicate name — a number was added

merge.title: Merge
merge.hint: Drag the list below to change the merge order.

images.title: Images to PDF
images.hint: Drag the list below to reorder pages. Each image is centred on one A4 sheet.
images.heicHint: Photos taken on an iPhone default to HEIC, which this tool can't read: go to Settings → Camera → Formats and choose "Most Compatible", or export the photo as JPG first.

interleave.title: Interleave
interleave.dropFront: Drop the PDF of the scanned fronts here
interleave.dropBack: Drop the PDF of the scanned backs here
interleave.reverse: Backs are in reverse order (whole stack flipped)
interleave.reverseHint: The usual case with a single-sided scanner: you flip the whole stack after scanning the fronts, so the backs come out reversed. Uncheck this if you flipped each sheet individually.
interleave.counts: {front} front pages and {back} back pages will merge into {total} pages.
interleave.needBoth: Please choose both the front and the back PDF first.

organize.title: Organize pages
organize.hint: Drag thumbnails to reorder. Use ↻ to rotate and ✕ to delete (click again to restore).
organize.allDeleted: Every page is marked for deletion — please keep at least one.

nup.title: N-up
nup.gutterHint: 1 pt is about 0.35 mm. Default is 10 pt.
nup.gutterClamped: The gap was too large, so it was limited to {max} pt — otherwise the layout would have no room left for content.

margin.title: Marking margin
margin.sizeHint: 40 mm by default — about the width of a typical comment column.
margin.rotateNote: Rotated pages are handled so the margin lands on the edge you actually see.
margin.sizeClampedMin: The margin width can't be less than {min} mm — it was adjusted automatically.
margin.sizeClampedMax: The margin width was too large, so it was limited to {max} mm — otherwise the layout would become impractical.

hub.splitDesc: Cut a stack of scanned homework into one file every N pages, named from your class list.
hub.mergeDesc: Combine several PDFs into one, in the order you set.
hub.interleaveDesc: Scanned fronts and backs separately? Weave them back into the right page order.
hub.imagesDesc: Turn photos or screenshots into a single A4 PDF.
hub.organizeDesc: See every page as a thumbnail — rotate, delete, reorder.
hub.nupDesc: Fit 2 or 4 pages onto one A4 sheet to save paper.
hub.marginDesc: Add blank space to every page for handwritten comments.
